## The HR Scaling Challenge

Rapid growth strains HR capacity. Every new hire needs onboarding, benefits enrollment, and compliance paperwork—but HR headcount rarely scales proportionally.

M&A integrations, HRIS implementations, and compliance audits create project-based HR needs that don't justify permanent hires.

HR consulting firms charge premium rates. You need experienced HR professionals at operational costs, not strategic consulting fees.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- HR generalists who can handle the full employee lifecycle
- Recruiters and talent acquisition specialists for hiring surges
- HRIS specialists familiar with Workday, BambooHR, ADP, and other platforms
- Compliance and employee relations expertise for audits and investigations
- Flexible engagements that align with growth phases and project timelines
